Definition: Mijamin, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Miamin or Mijamin = "from the right hand"; 1) chief of the 6th course of priests established by David; 2) a priest who signed the covenant with Nehemiah; 3) a priest who went up with Zerubbabel; 4) a priest who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
